tender.title: The Provision of Specialist Building Management System (BMS) Maintenance
tender.description:
The Authority requires a Contractor to provide specialist Building Management System (BMS)
maintenance services across the Trust estate. 

The scope shall include, as a minimum:
• Planned Preventative Maintenance (PPM): delivery of routine inspection, testing,
calibration and maintenance activities for all identified BMS assets in accordance with
SFG20 guidance, manufacturer recommendations and statutory requirements.
• Reactive maintenance and fault response: provision of reactive call-out services,
fault diagnosis, repairs and system recovery support to maintain operational continuity
across critical engineering systems.
• BMS controls and software support: maintenance and support of the Trust's Trend
BMS infrastructure, including controllers, outstations, field devices, software platforms,
graphics, alarms and associated network interfaces.
• System optimisation and performance monitoring: monitoring, adjustment and
optimisation of BMS controls strategies to support operational efficiency, environmental
control and energy performance across the estate.
• Asset information and reporting: maintenance and updating of BMS asset registers,
maintenance records, service reports and associated documentation to support
compliance and lifecycle management.
• Technical support and specialist attendance: provision of suitably qualified BMS
engineers to undertake specialist diagnostic investigations, technical advice and
support for planned works, shutdowns and operational issues.

tender.title: Ratton School Specialist Base - Project Manager, Technical Advisor  Consultancy Services
tender.description:
East Sussex County Council (ESCC) requires the appointment of an independent Project Manager and Technical Advisor (PM/TA) to support the delivery of a school project utilising a Modern Methods of Construction (MMC) solution. The PM/TA will provide overall project management, governance, programme management, stakeholder engagement, risk and change management, together with independent technical assurance throughout the design, manufacture, construction, commissioning and defects phases of the project.

The requirement is needed to ensure ESCC acts as an informed client and receives objective, evidence-based advice throughout the project lifecycle. Given the specialist nature of MMC delivery and the need to maintain robust oversight of programme, quality, statutory compliance, design development and construction activities, ESCC requires an experienced consultant capable of providing both project management leadership and independent technical assurance.

The key objectives of the procurement were to:

•	Appoint a suitably qualified and experienced consultant with expertise in project management and technical assurance for MMC projects.
•	Provide ESCC with independent oversight and challenge of design, manufacturing and construction activities.
•	Ensure compliance with statutory requirements, Building Regulations, fire safety, accessibility standards and SEND-specific requirements.
•	Support effective project governance, stakeholder engagement, risk management and decision-making.
•	Protect the Council's interests by providing quality assurance, programme monitoring and independent technical advice throughout project delivery.
•	Deliver value for money whilst ensuring successful project outcomes and minimising project risk.
